title: Because PostgreSQL is the sole database engine from day one and all persistence goes…
description: Because PostgreSQL is the sole database engine from day one and all persistence goes through EF Core's provider-agnostic APIs (AD-003), this scaling path requires only infrastructure and configuration changes — never a Domain/Application rewrite, and never a database migration.
